# Gorilla Rigged and Animated 3D Model

Gorilla Rigged And Animated 3D Model includes 06 Realistic Animations. Gorilla Rigged And Animated 3D Model Character has been fully Blender Advanced rigged. Gorilla Rigged And Animated 3D Model character has its own animations which is based on realistic methodology. You can easily append this character into your scene. This model can also be used for your games. This Gorilla Rigged And Animated 3D Model animation pack is simple to use and will save a lot of time. By following a few simple steps, you may use this character to create any scene or movie without wasting time on modelling, rigging, and animations.

![](https://assets.superhivemarket.com/cache/f70b67b78d079c9f2bcbcac59e4835d9.jpg)

# Advanced Blender Rigging:

# ![](https://assets.superhivemarket.com/cache/82b5535770627da67ab887684fe82291.jpg)

# Realistic Gorilla Rigged and Animated 3D ModelAnimations:

# ![](https://assets.superhivemarket.com/cache/ffca92f41420afbcfda9cd5e4c9c90c8.gif)

# Gorilla Rigged and Animated 3D ModelAnimations List:\_

# 1. Attack 2. Death 3. Idle 4. Roar 5. Run 6. Walk

## 🚀 Quick Start: Bring Your Scorpion to Life!

## Getting your new animated model into your project is a breeze. Follow these 3 simple steps to get rendering in seconds:

### 1️⃣ Import the Collection

# 1. For a perfect setup with all meshes, armatures, and materials intact, Append the Collection instead of individual objects.    - In your new scene, go to File > Append.          - Locate the `Gorilla Rigged And Animated 3D Model.blend` file.          - Open the Collection folder.          - Select "Gorilla rigged and animated 3D Model\_Main" and click Append.

### 2️⃣ Bring in the Animations

# 1. To ensure every custom movement is available in your new project:    - Go to File > Append again (same file).          - This time, open the Action folder.          - Select all listed animations (e.g., _Walk, Attack, Idle_) and click Append.

### 3️⃣ Activate & Play!

# 1. Now, simply "plug in" the animations to the rig:            - Select the Armature (the bones) in your 3D view.          - Switch your bottom window to the Action Editor (found inside the _Dope Sheet_).          - Click the Browse Action icon (the small picture button).          - Pick an animation from the list—your Gorilla rigged and Animated 3d Model will instantly snap into action!

# The Making of 3D Gorilla Animations: Capturing the Beast in Motion

[ActorCore](https://magazine.reallusion.com/filter/?tags=actorcore) [ActorCore Picks Content](https://magazine.reallusion.com/filter/?tags=actorcore-picks-content) [Character Animation](https://magazine.reallusion.com/filter/?tags=character-animation-theme) [Content](https://magazine.reallusion.com/filter/?tags=content) [Education](https://magazine.reallusion.com/filter/?tags=education) [Films & Movies](https://magazine.reallusion.com/filter/?tags=films-movies) [Games](https://magazine.reallusion.com/filter/?tags=games) [Motion Capture](https://magazine.reallusion.com/filter/?tags=motion-capture) [iClone](https://magazine.reallusion.com/filter/?tags=iclone)

Share

[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmagazine.reallusion.com%2F2025%2F11%2F10%2Fthe-making-of-3d-gorilla-animations%2F "Facebook")[Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmagazine.reallusion.com%2F2025%2F11%2F10%2Fthe-making-of-3d-gorilla-animations%2F "Linkedin")[X](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=The%20Making%20of%203D%20Gorilla%20Animations%3A%20Capturing%20the%20Beast%20in%20Motion&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmagazine.reallusion.com%2F2025%2F11%2F10%2Fthe-making-of-3d-gorilla-animations%2F "X")[Copy Link](https://magazine.reallusion.com/2025/11/10/the-making-of-3d-gorilla-animations/ "Copy Link")

## Over 130 lifelike gorilla movements, professionally performed and motion-captured.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-key-visual-1024x576.jpg)

## About ActorCore

Reallusion [ActorCore](https://reallusion.software/72o) is a premium motion capture library designed for professional 3D production, offering **over 4,700 high-quality animations** spanning a wide range of themes, from everyday actions and conversations to combat, stunts, and paired performances. Constantly pushing creative boundaries, ActorCore holds a reputation for delivering mocap animations that are often difficult, time-consuming, or costly for studios to produce on their own, while making them accessible and affordable to everyone.

## Gorilla Series

Following the acclaimed success of the _Wire Stunts_ and _Legendary Heroes_ series, Reallusion is now venturing beyond standard human motion with a new collection that explores primeval behaviors. Inspired by films such as _Planet of the Apes_, _Tarzan_, _King Kong_, and _Warcraft_, and supported by industry expertise and the production-scale resources of a major studio, this ambitious project captures authentic gorilla movements. While primate themes often appear on the big screen, this kind of motion data has been largely out of reach for 3D creators… until now.

In collaboration with [Quantum Stage](https://www.quantum-stage.com/), a professional motion capture studio in Switzerland renowned for its directing expertise and stunt performers capable of simulating realistic primal behaviors, Reallusion creates the [Gorilla Series](https://www.reallusion.com/ContentStore/iClone/3d-animation/gorilla-combo/default.html)—a distinctive collection of high-quality 3D animations available on the [ActorCore](https://reallusion.software/ba5c44) 3D asset store. These animations authentically capture the strength, movement, and personality of hulking gorillas, making them perfect for wildlife documentaries, zoo simulations, or cinematic storytelling.

See how the Quantum Stage process and professional mocap acting replicate lifelike gorilla movement:

## Research and Planning

To achieve natural movement, Reallusion and Quantum Stage conducted extensive research on gorilla behavior. The study organized actions into key categories: daily routines such as walking, running, crawling, and jumping; alert behaviors like scanning the environment and responding to threats; terrain navigation across different levels; and social interactions, including attacking, taunting, defending, and escaping. Together, the study has captured the full range of gorilla motion for use as a production reference.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-yt-%E5%8F%83%E8%80%832-1024x281.jpg)![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-yt-%E5%8F%83%E8%80%83-1024x281.jpg)

## Imitation of Gorilla Motion

Creating realistic gorilla animation involved two key steps. First, the mocap studio captured the human performer’s body and skeletal motion, much like a traditional motion capture session. The second step focused on accurately adapting these movements to a gorilla’s anatomy. Although gorillas share a similar skeletal structure with humans, their body proportions differ significantly: their hips, chest, and shoulders are much broader, their upper arms and forearms are considerably longer, and their legs are noticeably shorter. By carefully adjusting these proportions, the final animation preserves both anatomical accuracy and authentic primate movement.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-3%E8%A6%96%E5%9C%96-1024x281.jpg)

> “When we shot this animation we specifically observed gorilla motion and behavior from movies such as the King Kong series and Planet of the Apes, and also nature documentaries about how the primates behave with other animals and with each other. It is a very big part of the whole makeup of a gorilla and that shows in the performance. We tried to replicate these as closely as possible,”
>
> Tobias Baumann, Founder, Quantum Stage

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-%E5%A4%A7%E5%9C%962-1024x575.jpg)

## Preparing for Action

The most crucial element in capturing authentic gorilla motion is the performer. The actor must combine physical prowess with the creative ability to understand, visualize, and embody gorilla behavior and movement. With high-quality motion capture, every subtle emotion and intention of the performer is recorded, translating directly into the animated character’s movements and expressions.

For this project, the studio collaborated with **Ophir Raray**, a stunt actor and motion capture artist specializing in creature performances, wire stunts, and movement-based roles. With a background in gymnastics, capoeira, and military training, he brought both life and realism to the gorilla performance. The capture process was physically demanding and technically challenging, requiring the actor to maintain consistent energy, posture, and motion, so that all movements flowed naturally from a precise starting point.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%962-1024x500.jpg)

> “The preparation involves a lot of research, including researches of animals, apes, and gorillas, their movements, also their psychology, sounds and breath, which are some of the most important things for the performance, to give a life-like performance that the audience can really feel,”
>
> Ophir Raray, creature performer and movement expert

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-%E5%A4%A7%E5%9C%963-1024x575.jpg)

## The Right Tool for the Job

To ensure accurate kinesthetics, the team used arm extensions, allowing Raray to mimic the true skeletal proportions of a gorilla. This tool enabled him to move with the correct weight, rhythm, and balance, fully transforming his performance into that of a believable primate. These techniques and tools were essential in bridging human expression and performance with animal motion and behavior, ensuring that the animation captured not only anatomical accuracy but also conveyed personality and emotion.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-%E6%94%AF%E6%92%90%E5%99%A8-1024x575.jpg)

> “Using arm extensions is a very specialized skill, and it requires the body parts, muscles and movements that you normally don’t use. It’s a behavior that you as a human never really experience but the tools allow you to actually move like a gorilla and you can really feel that you are becoming a gorilla,”
>
> Ophir Raray, creature performer and movement expert

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-%E5%A4%A7%E5%9C%964-1024x575.jpg)

## Available Now on ActorCore

A product of hours of dedication and passion, the [Gorilla Series](https://www.reallusion.com/ContentStore/iClone/3d-animation/gorilla-combo/default.html) is now available on ActorCore. The pack includes four motion categories: [Routines](https://reallusion.software/xuo) **,** [Locomotion](https://reallusion.software/d9b25f) **,** [Aggression](https://reallusion.software/f5edd6) **,** and Evasion. The full collection features **131 mocap motions** designed for jungle scenes, wildlife simulations, educational content, or any project that requires realistic gorilla movement and behavior.

Whether you’re creating games, cinematic animations, or storytelling sequences, this motion set provides the versatility needed to bring your scenes to life. The collection also includes core poses, instinctual reactions, expressive gestures, combat responses, and terrain-based movements. The Gorilla Series offers the perfect mocap content to bring wildlife adventures into your productions.

## Over 130 lifelike gorilla movements, professionally performed and motion-captured.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-key-visual-1024x576.jpg)

## About ActorCore

Reallusion [ActorCore](https://reallusion.software/72o) is a premium motion capture library designed for professional 3D production, offering **over 4,700 high-quality animations** spanning a wide range of themes, from everyday actions and conversations to combat, stunts, and paired performances. Constantly pushing creative boundaries, ActorCore holds a reputation for delivering mocap animations that are often difficult, time-consuming, or costly for studios to produce on their own, while making them accessible and affordable to everyone.

## Gorilla Series

Following the acclaimed success of the _Wire Stunts_ and _Legendary Heroes_ series, Reallusion is now venturing beyond standard human motion with a new collection that explores primeval behaviors. Inspired by films such as _Planet of the Apes_, _Tarzan_, _King Kong_, and _Warcraft_, and supported by industry expertise and the production-scale resources of a major studio, this ambitious project captures authentic gorilla movements. While primate themes often appear on the big screen, this kind of motion data has been largely out of reach for 3D creators… until now.

In collaboration with [Quantum Stage](https://www.quantum-stage.com/), a professional motion capture studio in Switzerland renowned for its directing expertise and stunt performers capable of simulating realistic primal behaviors, Reallusion creates the [Gorilla Series](https://www.reallusion.com/ContentStore/iClone/3d-animation/gorilla-combo/default.html)—a distinctive collection of high-quality 3D animations available on the [ActorCore](https://reallusion.software/ba5c44) 3D asset store. These animations authentically capture the strength, movement, and personality of hulking gorillas, making them perfect for wildlife documentaries, zoo simulations, or cinematic storytelling.

See how the Quantum Stage process and professional mocap acting replicate lifelike gorilla movement:

## Research and Planning

To achieve natural movement, Reallusion and Quantum Stage conducted extensive research on gorilla behavior. The study organized actions into key categories: daily routines such as walking, running, crawling, and jumping; alert behaviors like scanning the environment and responding to threats; terrain navigation across different levels; and social interactions, including attacking, taunting, defending, and escaping. Together, the study has captured the full range of gorilla motion for use as a production reference.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-yt-%E5%8F%83%E8%80%832-1024x281.jpg)![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-yt-%E5%8F%83%E8%80%83-1024x281.jpg)

## Imitation of Gorilla Motion

Creating realistic gorilla animation involved two key steps. First, the mocap studio captured the human performer’s body and skeletal motion, much like a traditional motion capture session. The second step focused on accurately adapting these movements to a gorilla’s anatomy. Although gorillas share a similar skeletal structure with humans, their body proportions differ significantly: their hips, chest, and shoulders are much broader, their upper arms and forearms are considerably longer, and their legs are noticeably shorter. By carefully adjusting these proportions, the final animation preserves both anatomical accuracy and authentic primate movement.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-3%E8%A6%96%E5%9C%96-1024x281.jpg)

> “When we shot this animation we specifically observed gorilla motion and behavior from movies such as the King Kong series and Planet of the Apes, and also nature documentaries about how the primates behave with other animals and with each other. It is a very big part of the whole makeup of a gorilla and that shows in the performance. We tried to replicate these as closely as possible,”
>
> Tobias Baumann, Founder, Quantum Stage

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-%E5%A4%A7%E5%9C%962-1024x575.jpg)

## Preparing for Action

The most crucial element in capturing authentic gorilla motion is the performer. The actor must combine physical prowess with the creative ability to understand, visualize, and embody gorilla behavior and movement. With high-quality motion capture, every subtle emotion and intention of the performer is recorded, translating directly into the animated character’s movements and expressions.

For this project, the studio collaborated with **Ophir Raray**, a stunt actor and motion capture artist specializing in creature performances, wire stunts, and movement-based roles. With a background in gymnastics, capoeira, and military training, he brought both life and realism to the gorilla performance. The capture process was physically demanding and technically challenging, requiring the actor to maintain consistent energy, posture, and motion, so that all movements flowed naturally from a precise starting point.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%962-1024x500.jpg)

> “The preparation involves a lot of research, including researches of animals, apes, and gorillas, their movements, also their psychology, sounds and breath, which are some of the most important things for the performance, to give a life-like performance that the audience can really feel,”
>
> Ophir Raray, creature performer and movement expert

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-%E5%A4%A7%E5%9C%963-1024x575.jpg)

## The Right Tool for the Job

To ensure accurate kinesthetics, the team used arm extensions, allowing Raray to mimic the true skeletal proportions of a gorilla. This tool enabled him to move with the correct weight, rhythm, and balance, fully transforming his performance into that of a believable primate. These techniques and tools were essential in bridging human expression and performance with animal motion and behavior, ensuring that the animation captured not only anatomical accuracy but also conveyed personality and emotion.

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-%E6%94%AF%E6%92%90%E5%99%A8-1024x575.jpg)

> “Using arm extensions is a very specialized skill, and it requires the body parts, muscles and movements that you normally don’t use. It’s a behavior that you as a human never really experience but the tools allow you to actually move like a gorilla and you can really feel that you are becoming a gorilla,”
>
> Ophir Raray, creature performer and movement expert

![](https://magazine.reallusion.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/gorilla-%E9%9B%9C%E8%AA%8C%E9%85%8D%E5%9C%96-%E5%A4%A7%E5%9C%964-1024x575.jpg)

## Available Now on ActorCore

A product of hours of dedication and passion, the [Gorilla Series](https://www.reallusion.com/ContentStore/iClone/3d-animation/gorilla-combo/default.html) is now available on ActorCore. The pack includes four motion categories: [Routines](https://reallusion.software/xuo) **,** [Locomotion](https://reallusion.software/d9b25f) **,** [Aggression](https://reallusion.software/f5edd6) **,** and Evasion. The full collection features **131 mocap motions** designed for jungle scenes, wildlife simulations, educational content, or any project that requires realistic gorilla movement and behavior.

Whether you’re creating games, cinematic animations, or storytelling sequences, this motion set provides the versatility needed to bring your scenes to life. The collection also includes core poses, instinctual reactions, expressive gestures, combat responses, and terrain-based movements. The Gorilla Series offers the perfect mocap content to bring wildlife adventures into your productions.

  "markdown": "# Content License Policy

Royalty Free \| Perpetual \| Commercial Use

License Update (2025.8.1)

## CONTENT POLICY

Reallusion is dedicated to building a comprehensive digital content platform that empowers creators at every level, from individual artists and indie developers to studios and enterprise teams. Our extensive asset library supports everything from character creation to animation production, offering royalty-free, perpetual licenses for personal and commercial use.

To better serve our users and adapt to evolving creative workflows and industries, we are excited to introduce two important updates to our Content Policy:


1. Expanded Standard License Coverage

We’re expanding the Standard License to include features that were previously exclusive to the Extended License. With this single license, creators can now freely export content to external tools and engines such as Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, Maya, and more. You’re no longer limited to using just one character or locked into a single workflow.

The Standard License now grants you full rights to:




   - Export content to any external software or game engine
   - Reuse purchased assets across unlimited characters and projects
   - Expand your content library without restrictive or confusing terms
   - For mass distribution in final image/video outputs, game titles, or AR/VR projects

2. Introducing the iContent License for Internal Workflows

For creators who work entirely within the Reallusion ecosystem, the new iContent License provides an affordable and focused alternative. Priced at just 30 percent of the Standard License, it’s the perfect solution for internal production, in-software rendering, education, and concept development.


    Use the iContent License when:




   - You are rendering directly in iClone or Character Creator
   - Projects are saved and shared within iClone in Character Creator
   - You are building scenes for previsualization or storyboarding
   - No external export is needed
   - iContent is only available in-software purchase

This budget-friendly option is ideal for students, internal teams, or anyone who creates exclusively within Reallusion's software suite and does not need cross-platform deployment.


## REALLUSION LICENSING BENEFITS

The Content Licensing adopts a three-tier model designed to cover all user needs. Users can utilize the content according to their requirements in image and video output, games, apps, AR/VR projects, the AEC industry, simulation, and Digital Twin applications.

For special use cases beyond the aforementioned categories, Enterprise Licensing can be requested for special arrangements such as AI training, machine learning, and the integration of Reallusion assets into applications and services.

Here are the six major benefits of Reallusion Content Licensing:




![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Royalty-Free-Perpetual-License.jpg)

Royalty Free Perpetual License


One-time purchase and use forever.

Unlimited projects.

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Game_XR_Apps.jpg)

Use in Games, Apps, AR/VR Projects


Content usage for image and video outputs, or in games, applications, XR for mass distribution. See [Licensing Options](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#models) for more information.

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/iContent.jpg)

Budget-Friendly iContent License


Create projects or render images and videos in iClone and Character Creator for commercial use at just 30% of the Standard License cost.

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Workgroup.jpg)

Content Sharing Among Workgroup Members


A studio or production house can store and share all purchased content with one workgroup account.

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/to-Your-Clients.jpg)

Assigning Finished Works[\[1\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#notes) to Your Clients

Contractors can assign usage rights of their finished products to their clients

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Enterprise-License-and-Special-Request.jpg)

Enterprise Licensing & Special Requests

Request for content resell or redistribution, including machine learning, AI generation, application & service integration and more. [Inquire >](https://www.reallusion.com/license/enterprise.html)

## Shop for Content Now

## Notes

1. Assign Finished Works:  As a contractor working on a project for a client, you may use your purchased content to complete the assignment. Your client will receive the same usage rights for the final deliverables, including images, videos, games, apps, and AR/VR projects, as long as they comply with the Reallusion Content EULA.

2. Restriction on Special Usage Requests :


   - Licensed content or derivatives thereof may not be used for in-app purchases.
   - Licensed content or derivatives thereof may not be used in a way that competes with Reallusion, including distribution through image libraries, stock videos, online market for 3D models or any other similar services.

3. 3D Assets: With the Standard License, all exportable 3D Assets, including CC components, are allowed to be used in games, apps and AR/VR projects.

4. CC Component: CC Component is Character Creator’s proprietary file format used for character generation. These components include, but are not limited to, ccAvatars, ccProjects, ccSliders, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes, and ccGloves, which can be used to create, assemble, or customize unlimited characters.



A Standard License grants the right to use characters made with CC Components for all commercial imagery. With a one-time purchase of the Standard License, you can repeatedly use CC Components to create characters for different titles or projects.



## Content License FAQ

01. Q1. What’s the essence and benefit of the content policy to all users?![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/hint/important.gif)



    1. Standard License is Export Ready:

       All exportable contents in Reallusion’s stores can be used for any personal and commercial imagery (image/video outputs), games, AR/VR projects and interactive services with the Standard License.

    2. Extended License is for Mass Character Production:

       Only applicable to CC Components. CC Component is Character Creator’s proprietary file format. CC Components include, but are not limited to ccAvatars, ccProjects, ccSliders, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes and ccGloves that are used to create, assemble, or customize unlimited characters.


        Standard Licenses grant the use of characters with CC Components for all commercial imagery. However, for use in commercial games, XR projects and interactive services, one Standard License only grants outputs for one single character. Extended License grants mass character outputs with no limitation for use in commercial games, XR projects and online interactive services. You can repeatedly use CC components to create characters for different titles or projects with a one-time purchase of the Extended License.



02. Q2. What types of content require Extended licensing?


     Extended Licenses[\[a\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#a) are required for CC Components[\[b\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#b)such as ccAvatar, ccProject, ccSlider, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes and ccGloves if they are used on characters in games, applications or XR projects. You can also check the individual content pack's webpage in the RL Content Store for the “Extended License Price” under the standard price[\[c\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#c); The presence of which is a sign that the item requires Extended Licensing. Use of CC Components in non-commercial or non-distributed games, applications or XR projects does not required the purchase of Extended Licensing.





    \[a\]

    ![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Extended.svg)

    Extended icon indicates that this content requires Extended License for use in games and XR projects for mass distribution.







    \[b\]

    ![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/CC%20Component.svg)

    CC Component icon indicates that this content contains ccAvatar, ccProject, ccSlider, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes or ccGloves. Purchase of Extended Licenses for CC Components are required if they are used on characters in games, applications or XR projects for mass distribution.







    \[c\]















    ![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)



    ![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)














    This video does not exist.







    ▲ Content Store licensing options and price display




















    ![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)



    ![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

    ▲ Landing page licensing options and price display




















    ![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

    ▲ Marketplace licensing options and DA Points Display


03. Q3. How are the Standard and Extended Licenses different from the legacy iContent and Export Licenses?


     The legacy rights for iContent and Export License fall within the purview of the Standard License.Purchase of Extended Licenses for CC Components[\[2\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#notes) are required if they are used on characters in games, applications or XR projects for mass distribution. Before July 27th, 2022, you can apply for MDR certificates by contacting our Marketing Team. After that, you’ll need to go through the process of purchasing either the Standard, Extended, or Enterprise licenses.


04. Q4. I have purchased Export Licenses for some CC Component[\[2\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#notes) content prior to July 27th, 2022; Do I still need to pay for the new Extended License if I use them in my game or projects in the future?


     Export-ready content that are purchased before July 27th, 2022 will receive FREE Extended Licenses (automatically applied to the product inventory). For later purchases made after July 27th, 2022, customers need to pick the proper type of license while adding items to the shopping cart.


05. Q5. I want to use Reallusion assets in 3rd party software such as Maya, Blender, ZBrush, etc., which license is right for me?


     The Standard License allows you to export 3D objects and characters to any other software.


06. Q6. Do you offer upgrade prices for Standard Licenses to Extended Licenses?


     Standard Licenses can not be upgraded to Extended Licenses; the two licenses must be purchased separately in the Content Store. Users should pick the appropriate type of license at the time of purchase.


07. Q7. Do I only need to purchase the Extended License once to apply it to all my projects?


     Yes, Extended Licenses are perpetual and allow for use of the licensed content in an unlimited number of projects under the purchaser’s account.


08. Q8. As a contractor who uses Extended Licenses for work, what rights are extended to my clients?


     Clients are also covered under the contractor's Extended License agreements without making additional purchases. Under these agreements, clients have the right to use export files of Extended License content (in fbx, obj, usd, and other proprietary formats), and they can use the content for games, XR, and apps. However, clients aren’t allowed to republish licensed content for sale in online stores, in-app purchases, character creation, etc. iContent/ccContent are still DRM protected, so clients will need to purchase the source content to edit the contractor’s projects in CC or iClone.


09. Q9. I'm interested in building a character creation system in my application utilizing Character Creator assets; what type of license do I need?


     Please contact Reallusion directly to inquire about the Enterprise License.


10. Q10. Is there any way to apply for free Mass Distribution Rights certificate?


     No, Reallusion no longer accepts free Mass Distribution Rights applications by email. Please follow our new Content License policy and purchase the license model which suits your needs, directly from our stores. If you wish to get featured by Reallusion, or seek marketing support, please contact [marketing@reallusion.com](mailto:marketing@reallusion.com), or check our [Pitch & Produce program](https://www.reallusion.com/pitch-produce/).


11. Q11. Do iClone 8 and Character Creator 4 embedded content carry an Extended license?


     If the embedded content items are CC Components content, then they include an Extended license already. If they are non CC Components content, then they only include a Standard license.



CONTENT LICENSE FAQ

- General
- Game Developer
- iContent

1. Can I use my purchased content for game production and distributing my game title?




    Yes, you can use your purchased content in your game production and for distributing your game title.

2. I want to build a character creation system using Character Creator assets. What type of license do I need?




    Using the Character Creator base model for any character generation system or commercial character creation feature is not permitted under the Reallusion EULA.

3. Can I use my purchased content across all my projects?




    Yes. You may use your purchased content in multiple projects without needing to purchase an additional license for each one.


4. I am a contractor. How can I deliver my work to clients if it includes purchased content?




    As a contractor working on a project for a client, you may use your purchased content to complete the assignment. Your client will receive the same usage rights for the final deliverables, including images, videos, games, apps, and AR/VR projects, as long as they comply with the Reallusion Content EULA.




However, if you need to deliver original project files (e.g., iClone, Character Creator, or Cartoon Animator files), your client will need to purchase the same content licenses in order to remove DRM watermarks and access the files without limitations.


5. As an RL Workgroup owner, can I share my purchased content with my team members?




    Yes. If you've purchased content under a Workgroup account, all members within your Workgroup can access and use the content without needing to purchase additional licenses. For more information, view the details of the [**Workgroup Plan**](https://www.reallusion.com/workgroup/).


6. I purchased content under the previous Standard License. Does it still apply under the new Standard License Policy?




    Yes. All Standard Licenses, regardless of when they were purchased, are covered under the new Standard License policy.



01. HOTWhat is iContent and the iContent license?





    - **iContent** is a proprietary file format developed by Reallusion for exclusive use and purchase within its software ecosystem, such as iClone and Character Creator. Assets in the **iContent format are restricted to in-app use and** **can only be exported as rendered images or videos**—not as 3D files compatible with third-party software.
    - Not all items in the Reallusion store are available under an iContent license. When offered, an iContent license can cover various asset types, including characters, hairstyles, outfits, accessories, and props.
    - **Categories Offering an iContent License (Available via software purchase only)**
      - iClone: [**Actor**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=ic_avatar&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Scenes & Props**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=ic_props&platform=Windows&Nav=Top)
      - Character Creator: [**Actor**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_Actor&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Morph**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_morph&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Outfit**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_outfit&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Accessory**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_accessory&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Hair**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_hair&platform=Windows&Nav=Top)

02. What are the differences between the iContent License and the Standard License?





    - The **iContent License** restricts usage of assets within the Reallusion ecosystem, such as iClone and Character Creator. Assets under this license cannot be exported to third-party applications and are limited to rendering still images or videos within the Reallusion environment.
    - In contrast, the **Standard License** permits exporting assets for use in third-party software like Blender, Maya, Unity, Unreal Engine, and others. These assets are typically available in formats such as FBX or OBJ, making them suitable for roundtrip workflows, final rendering, or integration into external game engines and pipelines.

03. HOTWhere can I purchase iContent?



    **You can purchase an iContent license exclusively via Smart Search -> Instant Purchase.**Just follow these steps:






1. Start [**AI Smart Search**](https://www.reallusion.com/ai-smart-search/default.html) to find the content you need.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

2. Right-click on Instant Purchase for the item you want.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

3. Select the iContent license and proceed to checkout (ensure you have enough DA Points).

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

4. After the purchase, click OK and refresh. Your content will appear in the Smart Content Manager.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

04. How is the iContent License priced?




     iContent licenses are typically priced about 70% lower than their Standard License counterparts. For example, an asset priced at $12 under the Standard License would cost only $4 with an iContent license.


05. What are the benefits of iContent?




     iContent offers several advantages for Reallusion users:


    - Affordability: Build a large library of high-quality assets at a significantly lower cost.
    - Render-Ready: Perfect for creating images and videos directly within iClone and Character Creator.
    - Flexible Upgrade: Easily upgrade to a Standard License by paying only the price difference, enabling export to third-party software whenever needed.

06. How do I upgrade my iContent License to the Standard License?




     You can upgrade your iContent assets to the Standard License through several methods:



    - **Via Software (Character Creator or iClone)**

    1. Open the drop-down menu and go to **Inventory List** (near the bottom).

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

4. Proceed to your shopping cart and complete the checkout process.![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

    - **Via ActorCore**

1. Visit the ActorCore Store.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

2. Search for the asset you wish to upgrade and add it to your cart.

3. Go to your shopping cart (the upgrade discount will be automatically applied).

4\. Proceed to checkout.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

07. Where can I find my iContent after purchase?




     After purchasing, your iContent will appear in the software through the Smart Content Manager. To upgrade your content license, log in to your Reallusion account and go to [**Marketplace > Inventory List.**](https://marketplace.reallusion.com/inventory-list)




    Smart Content Manager:

    ![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

08. Is there a difference between purchasing content within Reallusion software and from the Reallusion online stores?




     Available purchase options vary by store type.

09. How do I top up my DA Points after they run out?




     Click the green button on the right side of the menu bar in your Reallusion application, or visit the [**Reallusion DA Points landing page**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/buydapoint.html) to add more points.



    ![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXefD1Oqm66SstWeNQ7xQZd7HzBgeqgv6GKbXaCq3d3ctIkrwGVO2laY9fkvT1gOd2k4MHKHxS8jhV3309rFaypOZfKEtT0TirWXkiSx2Zh9LIe62WCubVtfVEo9IZqwCH-YDsYDZQ?key=2WdrZQ9NlqMdMzcnox2vvA)

10. Does the PRIME 15% discount apply to purchases made within Reallusion software?




     Yes. If you're a Reallusion **PRIME member**, the 15% discount is automatically applied to all content purchased within the software. This discount applies to both Standard and iContent licenses.


11. Can I still try out content before purchasing it in the software?




     Yes. Many items in the **Smart Search** panel within iClone and Character Creator offer trial versions. Trial content lets you test the asset in your project with certain limitations, such as watermarks and export restrictions, before making a purchase.


12. What is the daily download limit for trial content?

13. Can I refund my purchase of iContent?




     All content purchases are non-refundable, including those under the iContent, Standard, and Extended licenses. Please review your order carefully before completing your purchase.



01. Can I use Reallusion Content to develop a commercial game?



    **Yes.** Under the Standard License, applicable exportable Reallusion Content—including embedded content and content purchased from the Content Store, Marketplace, and ActorCore—may be used to develop commercial games.


02. Do I need an Enterprise License simply because my game is commercial?



    **No.** Developing a commercial game does not, by itself, require an Enterprise License. The Standard License covers typical commercial game development using applicable Reallusion Content.


03. Can I export Reallusion characters and assets to Unreal Engine or Unity?



    **Yes.** Under the Standard License, applicable Reallusion Content can be exported to and used in game engines such as Unreal Engine, Unity, and other supported game engines.


04. Can I use Reallusion characters as player characters and NPCs?



    **Yes.** Under the Standard License, applicable Reallusion characters may be used as both playable characters and NPCs in commercial games.


05. Can Standard Licensed CC Components be reused across player characters and NPCs?



    **Yes.** Under the Standard License, applicable CC Components may be reused across characters and projects in commercial games.



    _(Note: CC Components are Character Creator’s component contents, including but not limited to ccAvatar, ccProject, ccPreset, ccSlider, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes, and ccGloves, which can be used in the Character Creator compose, assemble, modify, or customized into various CC Characters.)_

06. Can players equip and unequip individual Reallusion clothing items onto a game character during gameplay?



    **Yes.** Players may equip and unequip Reallusion clothing, hair, and accessories incorporated into the game, provided that the Reallusion Content is not separately distributed, sold, or made available as standalone content, nor packaged as DLC that allows extraction into any 3D file format.


07. Does a player inventory or equipment system count as in-game character generation?



    **No.** Allowing players to equip or unequip developer-provided clothing, hair, or accessories onto a character (including Character Creator Base Characters) does not by itself constitute character generation.


08. Can I create my own textures and materials for Reallusion assets?



    **Yes.** You may create original colors, patterns, camouflage, dirt, logos, materials, and other designs based on Reallusion’s clothing, shoes, gloves, hair, or accessories.


09. Can players create and distribute their own original textures through Steam Workshop for modding?



    **Yes.** You may distribute your original textures, materials, and UV templates through Steam Workshop, provided that the Workshop item does not include or redistribute the original Reallusion 3D mesh or other Reallusion Content. Pure 2D texture maps and UV templates created by you may be distributed.


10. Can I develop an in-game character generation system that allows players to create their own characters using Character Creator Base Characters or any Reallusion Content?



    **No.** Developing an in-game character creation or generation system that utilizes Character Creator Base Characters or any Reallusion Content requires an Enterprise License. For the official definition of a character generation system, please refer to Article 1.16 of the Reallusion Content End User License Agreement (EULA).



    _(Note: Providing players with morph sliders, bone manipulation, or parameters to alter a character's facial features, anatomy, body shape, or skeletal proportions during gameplay constitutes a character generation feature and strictly requires an Enterprise License. This restriction does not apply to standard cosmetic equipment systems (like changing hair, outfits, helmets, and accessories) or texture color pickers permitted under Questions 6 and 7.)_

11. Can I sell Reallusion-based characters or clothing as game DLC or add-on content?



    **No.** Reallusion Content cannot be separately sold or distributed as game add-on content under the Standard License.


12. What types of use require an Enterprise License? Enterprise is required for special use cases such as:





    - In-game or in-app character creation using Reallusion Content
    - Game DLC or add-on contents, paid or free
    - Integrating Reallusion Content into another application or service
    - API or server-based character generation
    - AI training or machine learning

# Content License Policy

Royalty Free \| Perpetual \| Commercial Use

License Update (2025.8.1)

## CONTENT POLICY

Reallusion is dedicated to building a comprehensive digital content platform that empowers creators at every level, from individual artists and indie developers to studios and enterprise teams. Our extensive asset library supports everything from character creation to animation production, offering royalty-free, perpetual licenses for personal and commercial use.

To better serve our users and adapt to evolving creative workflows and industries, we are excited to introduce two important updates to our Content Policy:


1. Expanded Standard License Coverage

We’re expanding the Standard License to include features that were previously exclusive to the Extended License. With this single license, creators can now freely export content to external tools and engines such as Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, Maya, and more. You’re no longer limited to using just one character or locked into a single workflow.

The Standard License now grants you full rights to:




   - Export content to any external software or game engine
   - Reuse purchased assets across unlimited characters and projects
   - Expand your content library without restrictive or confusing terms
   - For mass distribution in final image/video outputs, game titles, or AR/VR projects

2. Introducing the iContent License for Internal Workflows

For creators who work entirely within the Reallusion ecosystem, the new iContent License provides an affordable and focused alternative. Priced at just 30 percent of the Standard License, it’s the perfect solution for internal production, in-software rendering, education, and concept development.


    Use the iContent License when:




   - You are rendering directly in iClone or Character Creator
   - Projects are saved and shared within iClone in Character Creator
   - You are building scenes for previsualization or storyboarding
   - No external export is needed
   - iContent is only available in-software purchase

This budget-friendly option is ideal for students, internal teams, or anyone who creates exclusively within Reallusion's software suite and does not need cross-platform deployment.


## REALLUSION LICENSING BENEFITS

The Content Licensing adopts a three-tier model designed to cover all user needs. Users can utilize the content according to their requirements in image and video output, games, apps, AR/VR projects, the AEC industry, simulation, and Digital Twin applications.

For special use cases beyond the aforementioned categories, Enterprise Licensing can be requested for special arrangements such as AI training, machine learning, and the integration of Reallusion assets into applications and services.

Here are the six major benefits of Reallusion Content Licensing:




![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Royalty-Free-Perpetual-License.jpg)

Royalty Free Perpetual License


One-time purchase and use forever.

Unlimited projects.

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Game_XR_Apps.jpg)

Use in Games, Apps, AR/VR Projects


Content usage for image and video outputs, or in games, applications, XR for mass distribution. See [Licensing Options](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#models) for more information.

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/iContent.jpg)

Budget-Friendly iContent License


Create projects or render images and videos in iClone and Character Creator for commercial use at just 30% of the Standard License cost.

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Workgroup.jpg)

Content Sharing Among Workgroup Members


A studio or production house can store and share all purchased content with one workgroup account.

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/to-Your-Clients.jpg)

Assigning Finished Works[\[1\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#notes) to Your Clients

Contractors can assign usage rights of their finished products to their clients

![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Enterprise-License-and-Special-Request.jpg)

Enterprise Licensing & Special Requests

Request for content resell or redistribution, including machine learning, AI generation, application & service integration and more. [Inquire >](https://www.reallusion.com/license/enterprise.html)

## Notes

1. Assign Finished Works:  As a contractor working on a project for a client, you may use your purchased content to complete the assignment. Your client will receive the same usage rights for the final deliverables, including images, videos, games, apps, and AR/VR projects, as long as they comply with the Reallusion Content EULA.

2. Restriction on Special Usage Requests :


   - Licensed content or derivatives thereof may not be used for in-app purchases.
   - Licensed content or derivatives thereof may not be used in a way that competes with Reallusion, including distribution through image libraries, stock videos, online market for 3D models or any other similar services.

3. 3D Assets: With the Standard License, all exportable 3D Assets, including CC components, are allowed to be used in games, apps and AR/VR projects.

4. CC Component: CC Component is Character Creator’s proprietary file format used for character generation. These components include, but are not limited to, ccAvatars, ccProjects, ccSliders, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes, and ccGloves, which can be used to create, assemble, or customize unlimited characters.



A Standard License grants the right to use characters made with CC Components for all commercial imagery. With a one-time purchase of the Standard License, you can repeatedly use CC Components to create characters for different titles or projects.



## Content License FAQ

01. Q1. What’s the essence and benefit of the content policy to all users?![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/hint/important.gif)



    1. Standard License is Export Ready:

       All exportable contents in Reallusion’s stores can be used for any personal and commercial imagery (image/video outputs), games, AR/VR projects and interactive services with the Standard License.

    2. Extended License is for Mass Character Production:

       Only applicable to CC Components. CC Component is Character Creator’s proprietary file format. CC Components include, but are not limited to ccAvatars, ccProjects, ccSliders, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes and ccGloves that are used to create, assemble, or customize unlimited characters.


        Standard Licenses grant the use of characters with CC Components for all commercial imagery. However, for use in commercial games, XR projects and interactive services, one Standard License only grants outputs for one single character. Extended License grants mass character outputs with no limitation for use in commercial games, XR projects and online interactive services. You can repeatedly use CC components to create characters for different titles or projects with a one-time purchase of the Extended License.



02. Q2. What types of content require Extended licensing?


     Extended Licenses[\[a\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#a) are required for CC Components[\[b\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#b)such as ccAvatar, ccProject, ccSlider, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes and ccGloves if they are used on characters in games, applications or XR projects. You can also check the individual content pack's webpage in the RL Content Store for the “Extended License Price” under the standard price[\[c\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#c); The presence of which is a sign that the item requires Extended Licensing. Use of CC Components in non-commercial or non-distributed games, applications or XR projects does not required the purchase of Extended Licensing.





    \[a\]

    ![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/Extended.svg)

    Extended icon indicates that this content requires Extended License for use in games and XR projects for mass distribution.







    \[b\]

    ![](https://www.reallusion.com/license/images/CC%20Component.svg)

    CC Component icon indicates that this content contains ccAvatar, ccProject, ccSlider, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes or ccGloves. Purchase of Extended Licenses for CC Components are required if they are used on characters in games, applications or XR projects for mass distribution.

03. Q3. How are the Standard and Extended Licenses different from the legacy iContent and Export Licenses?


     The legacy rights for iContent and Export License fall within the purview of the Standard License.Purchase of Extended Licenses for CC Components[\[2\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#notes) are required if they are used on characters in games, applications or XR projects for mass distribution. Before July 27th, 2022, you can apply for MDR certificates by contacting our Marketing Team. After that, you’ll need to go through the process of purchasing either the Standard, Extended, or Enterprise licenses.


04. Q4. I have purchased Export Licenses for some CC Component[\[2\]](https://www.reallusion.com/license/content.html#notes) content prior to July 27th, 2022; Do I still need to pay for the new Extended License if I use them in my game or projects in the future?


     Export-ready content that are purchased before July 27th, 2022 will receive FREE Extended Licenses (automatically applied to the product inventory). For later purchases made after July 27th, 2022, customers need to pick the proper type of license while adding items to the shopping cart.


05. Q5. I want to use Reallusion assets in 3rd party software such as Maya, Blender, ZBrush, etc., which license is right for me?


     The Standard License allows you to export 3D objects and characters to any other software.


06. Q6. Do you offer upgrade prices for Standard Licenses to Extended Licenses?


     Standard Licenses can not be upgraded to Extended Licenses; the two licenses must be purchased separately in the Content Store. Users should pick the appropriate type of license at the time of purchase.


07. Q7. Do I only need to purchase the Extended License once to apply it to all my projects?


     Yes, Extended Licenses are perpetual and allow for use of the licensed content in an unlimited number of projects under the purchaser’s account.


08. Q8. As a contractor who uses Extended Licenses for work, what rights are extended to my clients?


     Clients are also covered under the contractor's Extended License agreements without making additional purchases. Under these agreements, clients have the right to use export files of Extended License content (in fbx, obj, usd, and other proprietary formats), and they can use the content for games, XR, and apps. However, clients aren’t allowed to republish licensed content for sale in online stores, in-app purchases, character creation, etc. iContent/ccContent are still DRM protected, so clients will need to purchase the source content to edit the contractor’s projects in CC or iClone.


09. Q9. I'm interested in building a character creation system in my application utilizing Character Creator assets; what type of license do I need?


     Please contact Reallusion directly to inquire about the Enterprise License.


10. Q10. Is there any way to apply for free Mass Distribution Rights certificate?


     No, Reallusion no longer accepts free Mass Distribution Rights applications by email. Please follow our new Content License policy and purchase the license model which suits your needs, directly from our stores. If you wish to get featured by Reallusion, or seek marketing support, please contact [marketing@reallusion.com](mailto:marketing@reallusion.com), or check our [Pitch & Produce program](https://www.reallusion.com/pitch-produce/).


11. Q11. Do iClone 8 and Character Creator 4 embedded content carry an Extended license?


     If the embedded content items are CC Components content, then they include an Extended license already. If they are non CC Components content, then they only include a Standard license.



CONTENT LICENSE FAQ

- General
- Game Developer
- iContent

1. Can I use my purchased content for game production and distributing my game title?




    Yes, you can use your purchased content in your game production and for distributing your game title.

2. I want to build a character creation system using Character Creator assets. What type of license do I need?




    Using the Character Creator base model for any character generation system or commercial character creation feature is not permitted under the Reallusion EULA.

3. Can I use my purchased content across all my projects?




    Yes. You may use your purchased content in multiple projects without needing to purchase an additional license for each one.


4. I am a contractor. How can I deliver my work to clients if it includes purchased content?




    As a contractor working on a project for a client, you may use your purchased content to complete the assignment. Your client will receive the same usage rights for the final deliverables, including images, videos, games, apps, and AR/VR projects, as long as they comply with the Reallusion Content EULA.




However, if you need to deliver original project files (e.g., iClone, Character Creator, or Cartoon Animator files), your client will need to purchase the same content licenses in order to remove DRM watermarks and access the files without limitations.


5. As an RL Workgroup owner, can I share my purchased content with my team members?




    Yes. If you've purchased content under a Workgroup account, all members within your Workgroup can access and use the content without needing to purchase additional licenses. For more information, view the details of the [**Workgroup Plan**](https://www.reallusion.com/workgroup/).


6. I purchased content under the previous Standard License. Does it still apply under the new Standard License Policy?




    Yes. All Standard Licenses, regardless of when they were purchased, are covered under the new Standard License policy.



01. HOTWhat is iContent and the iContent license?





    - **iContent** is a proprietary file format developed by Reallusion for exclusive use and purchase within its software ecosystem, such as iClone and Character Creator. Assets in the **iContent format are restricted to in-app use and** **can only be exported as rendered images or videos**—not as 3D files compatible with third-party software.
    - Not all items in the Reallusion store are available under an iContent license. When offered, an iContent license can cover various asset types, including characters, hairstyles, outfits, accessories, and props.
    - **Categories Offering an iContent License (Available via software purchase only)**
      - iClone: [**Actor**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=ic_avatar&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Scenes & Props**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=ic_props&platform=Windows&Nav=Top)
      - Character Creator: [**Actor**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_Actor&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Morph**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_morph&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Outfit**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_outfit&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Accessory**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_accessory&platform=Windows&Nav=Top), [**Hair**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/index.html?menuItem=cc_hair&platform=Windows&Nav=Top)

02. What are the differences between the iContent License and the Standard License?





    - The **iContent License** restricts usage of assets within the Reallusion ecosystem, such as iClone and Character Creator. Assets under this license cannot be exported to third-party applications and are limited to rendering still images or videos within the Reallusion environment.
    - In contrast, the **Standard License** permits exporting assets for use in third-party software like Blender, Maya, Unity, Unreal Engine, and others. These assets are typically available in formats such as FBX or OBJ, making them suitable for roundtrip workflows, final rendering, or integration into external game engines and pipelines.

03. HOTWhere can I purchase iContent?



    **You can purchase an iContent license exclusively via Smart Search -> Instant Purchase.**Just follow these steps:






1. Start [**AI Smart Search**](https://www.reallusion.com/ai-smart-search/default.html) to find the content you need.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

2. Right-click on Instant Purchase for the item you want.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

3. Select the iContent license and proceed to checkout (ensure you have enough DA Points).

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

4. After the purchase, click OK and refresh. Your content will appear in the Smart Content Manager.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

04. How is the iContent License priced?




     iContent licenses are typically priced about 70% lower than their Standard License counterparts. For example, an asset priced at $12 under the Standard License would cost only $4 with an iContent license.


05. What are the benefits of iContent?




     iContent offers several advantages for Reallusion users:


    - Affordability: Build a large library of high-quality assets at a significantly lower cost.
    - Render-Ready: Perfect for creating images and videos directly within iClone and Character Creator.
    - Flexible Upgrade: Easily upgrade to a Standard License by paying only the price difference, enabling export to third-party software whenever needed.

06. How do I upgrade my iContent License to the Standard License?




     You can upgrade your iContent assets to the Standard License through several methods:



    - **Via Software (Character Creator or iClone)**

1\. In your software, content with an iContent License will be displayed in green text.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

2\. Go to Help > View Unpurchased Items from the top menu.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

3. In the list, confirm the content you want to upgrade and click "View the Store Items".

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

4. Follow the store process to purchase the Standard License for the selected content. (The upgrade price will be shown automatically.)

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

4. After the purchase is complete, return to your software. A confirmation window will appear. Click “OK” to complete the upgrade process.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

    - **Via the Reallusion Content Store or Marketplace**

    1. Open the drop-down menu and go to **Inventory List** (near the bottom).

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

2. Filter your items by “iContent License” to locate eligible assets.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

3. Click **Upgrade** on the desired item. It will be added to your cart with the correct upgrade price.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

4. Proceed to your shopping cart and complete the checkout process.![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

    - **Via ActorCore**

1. Visit the ActorCore Store.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

2. Search for the asset you wish to upgrade and add it to your cart.

3. Go to your shopping cart (the upgrade discount will be automatically applied).

4\. Proceed to checkout.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

07. Where can I find my iContent after purchase?




     After purchasing, your iContent will appear in the software through the Smart Content Manager. To upgrade your content license, log in to your Reallusion account and go to [**Marketplace > Inventory List.**](https://marketplace.reallusion.com/inventory-list)




    Smart Content Manager:

    ![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

08. Is there a difference between purchasing content within Reallusion software and from the Reallusion online stores?




     Available purchase options vary by store type.




    Payment Options




    |     |     |     |     |     |
    | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
    | Payment Options | **In-Application** | **Content Store** | **Marketplace** | **ActorCore** |
    | Cash | - | ✅ Available | - | ✅ Available |
    | DA Points/Bonus Points | ✅ Available | ✅ Available | ✅ Available | ✅ Available |






    Available Licenses




    |     |     |     |     |     |
    | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
    | License type | In-Application | Content Store | Marketplace | ActorCore |
    | iContent license | ✅ Available | - | - | - |
    | Standard license | ✅ Available | ✅ Available | ✅ Available | ✅ Available |
    | Extended license | - | ✅ Available | ✅ Available | - |

09. How do I top up my DA Points after they run out?




     Click the green button on the right side of the menu bar in your Reallusion application, or visit the [**Reallusion DA Points landing page**](https://www.reallusion.com/contentstore/buydapoint.html) to add more points.



    ![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXefD1Oqm66SstWeNQ7xQZd7HzBgeqgv6GKbXaCq3d3ctIkrwGVO2laY9fkvT1gOd2k4MHKHxS8jhV3309rFaypOZfKEtT0TirWXkiSx2Zh9LIe62WCubVtfVEo9IZqwCH-YDsYDZQ?key=2WdrZQ9NlqMdMzcnox2vvA)

10. Does the PRIME 15% discount apply to purchases made within Reallusion software?




     Yes. If you're a Reallusion **PRIME member**, the 15% discount is automatically applied to all content purchased within the software. This discount applies to both Standard and iContent licenses.


11. Can I still try out content before purchasing it in the software?




     Yes. Many items in the **Smart Search** panel within iClone and Character Creator offer trial versions. Trial content lets you test the asset in your project with certain limitations, such as watermarks and export restrictions, before making a purchase.


12. What is the daily download limit for trial content?




     The daily download limit for trial content varies based on your Reallusion membership level.





    |     |     |     |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | Membership Type | Max Packs / Day | Max Items / Day |
    | PRIME member | 5 | 50 |
    | Regular (Non-Prime) | 3 | 10 |

13. Can I refund my purchase of iContent?




     All content purchases are non-refundable, including those under the iContent, Standard, and Extended licenses. Please review your order carefully before completing your purchase.



01. Can I use Reallusion Content to develop a commercial game?



    **Yes.** Under the Standard License, applicable exportable Reallusion Content—including embedded content and content purchased from the Content Store, Marketplace, and ActorCore—may be used to develop commercial games.


02. Do I need an Enterprise License simply because my game is commercial?



    **No.** Developing a commercial game does not, by itself, require an Enterprise License. The Standard License covers typical commercial game development using applicable Reallusion Content.


03. Can I export Reallusion characters and assets to Unreal Engine or Unity?



    **Yes.** Under the Standard License, applicable Reallusion Content can be exported to and used in game engines such as Unreal Engine, Unity, and other supported game engines.


04. Can I use Reallusion characters as player characters and NPCs?



    **Yes.** Under the Standard License, applicable Reallusion characters may be used as both playable characters and NPCs in commercial games.


05. Can Standard Licensed CC Components be reused across player characters and NPCs?



    **Yes.** Under the Standard License, applicable CC Components may be reused across characters and projects in commercial games.



    _(Note: CC Components are Character Creator’s component contents, including but not limited to ccAvatar, ccProject, ccPreset, ccSlider, ccHair, ccCloth, ccShoes, and ccGloves, which can be used in the Character Creator compose, assemble, modify, or customized into various CC Characters.)_

06. Can players equip and unequip individual Reallusion clothing items onto a game character during gameplay?



    **Yes.** Players may equip and unequip Reallusion clothing, hair, and accessories incorporated into the game, provided that the Reallusion Content is not separately distributed, sold, or made available as standalone content, nor packaged as DLC that allows extraction into any 3D file format.


07. Does a player inventory or equipment system count as in-game character generation?



    **No.** Allowing players to equip or unequip developer-provided clothing, hair, or accessories onto a character (including Character Creator Base Characters) does not by itself constitute character generation.


08. Can I create my own textures and materials for Reallusion assets?



    **Yes.** You may create original colors, patterns, camouflage, dirt, logos, materials, and other designs based on Reallusion’s clothing, shoes, gloves, hair, or accessories.


09. Can players create and distribute their own original textures through Steam Workshop for modding?



    **Yes.** You may distribute your original textures, materials, and UV templates through Steam Workshop, provided that the Workshop item does not include or redistribute the original Reallusion 3D mesh or other Reallusion Content. Pure 2D texture maps and UV templates created by you may be distributed.


10. Can I develop an in-game character generation system that allows players to create their own characters using Character Creator Base Characters or any Reallusion Content?



    **No.** Developing an in-game character creation or generation system that utilizes Character Creator Base Characters or any Reallusion Content requires an Enterprise License. For the official definition of a character generation system, please refer to Article 1.16 of the Reallusion Content End User License Agreement (EULA).



    _(Note: Providing players with morph sliders, bone manipulation, or parameters to alter a character's facial features, anatomy, body shape, or skeletal proportions during gameplay constitutes a character generation feature and strictly requires an Enterprise License. This restriction does not apply to standard cosmetic equipment systems (like changing hair, outfits, helmets, and accessories) or texture color pickers permitted under Questions 6 and 7.)_

11. Can I sell Reallusion-based characters or clothing as game DLC or add-on content?



    **No.** Reallusion Content cannot be separately sold or distributed as game add-on content under the Standard License.


12. What types of use require an Enterprise License? Enterprise is required for special use cases such as:





    - In-game or in-app character creation using Reallusion Content
    - Game DLC or add-on contents, paid or free
    - Integrating Reallusion Content into another application or service
    - API or server-based character generation
    - AI training or machine learning
    - Other uses outside the scope of the Standard License
